limitations: Canonical dirt/water straight and corner contact geometry is rebuilt at32. All old source features outside this core remain decorative and are not guaranteed interoperable.
Approved interior texture variation and repeated cobble patterns are unchanged; geometric compatibility does not imply every texture detail is seamless.
Water rock faces are reconstructed from approved bank pixels with fixed bottom-view occlusion; no rotation of final bank artwork.
Output only; no Unity import, metadata or production asset changes.
cornerDirectionMeaning: outer_NW/NE/SW/SE = convex GRASS quarter in named quadrant; inner_NW/NE/SW/SE = other-material concave CUTOUT in named quadrant, grass occupies remainder. Stone modules unchanged and use their prior perimeter-placement convention.
